column1: # P4-4-E2 (D4): the labels of the Modbus signature's corpus, written by corpus_label.py from corpus.tsv and TShark (Wireshark) 4.2.2 (Git v4.2.2 packaged as 4.2.2-1.1build3).

# One row per flow (D6's label-flow). src and sport name the client, dst and dport the server. syn: which end sent a SYN without ACK; first: which end sent the first frame. No payload byte and no host name.
